item.coloph: de ltar dbyings nas thugs dam brgyud bskul / mkha' la rang bzhin mnga' gsol/ klong du drag po'i las bcol ba 'di ni/ gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i lung don/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i snyan rgyud/ dam can 13 'di'i mjug ma tshang bas dpyad/

item.tib: dam can rgya mtsho'i klong du drag po'i las bcol
item.coloph: de+i ltar dbyings nas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul cing / mkha' la rang bzhin gyi mnga' gsol nas/ klong du drag po'i las bcol ba 'di ni/ gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i lung ston/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med gyi (kyis) snyan du rgyud (brgyud/)sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i dngos grub/ dam can gnad la bskul ba'i bkol byang*/ byad ma'i gtor sna bzlog pa'i don du/ bdag 'dra blo ldan snying po'i (pos) gtan la phab cing las la sbyar/ byin brlabs nus pa shin du myur ba 'di 'o//
